entities.summary: Baccio da Montelupo, was a sculptor of the Italian Renaissance. He was the father of another Italian sculptor, Raffaello da Montelupo. Both father and son are profiled in Vasari's Lives of the Most Excellent Painters, Sculptors, and Architects.
